title: He sold the Eiffel Tower. Twice.
hook: He sold the Eiffel Tower twice, and nobody stopped him.
twist: Nobody reported the crime, because the victim was too embarrassed.
payoff: So Lustig came back to Paris and tried to sell the tower a second time.
